affix-action.note: The built-in calendar button is a suffix action. Extra suffix actions compose beside it, for example a clear button.

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

appearance.label: Invoice date
appearance.note: Appearance follows the Form Field contract and also styles the calendar trigger.

basic.hint: Type a date or open the calendar.
basic.label: Invoice date

bounds.hint: Choose a date within the permitted period.
bounds.label: Delivery date

calendar-options.label: Start date
calendar-options.note: Week starts on the locale first day unless weekStartsOn overrides it. disablePast and disableFuture bound selection to today, and dateFormat switches day/month padding between 2-digit and numeric.

clearable.label: Invoice date
clearable.note: With clearable, a clear button appears when a date is set and emits cleared on click. It stays hidden while disabled, readonly, or loading.

date-picker.description: Locale-aware dates with manual entry and calendar selection. Also covers the Date Range Picker for start and end periods.

examples.note: Type a date manually or open the calendar popover. The value is a date-only ISO string.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the date picker components.

locale-bounds.note: Display and typing follow the locale. Min, max, and disabled dates bound the calendar and reject out-of-range input.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

basic.hint: Choose start and end dates, then apply.
basic.label: Reporting period

range.note: Date Range Picker collects a start and end date with presets, a pending panel, and Apply/Cancel. Size, density, loading, and suffix actions work the same as the single picker.

presets.hint: Pick a shortcut or choose custom dates.
presets.label: Reporting period with shortcuts

size-density.label: Invoice date
size-density.note: Size and density flow into the inner Form Field and input together, keeping label, field, and calendar trigger in sync.

states.note: Disabled blocks interaction, invalid surfaces a manual error, and loading shows the field skeleton while options resolve.

suffix-action.hint: Use the clear action to reset the value.
suffix-action.label: Invoice date

date-picker.title: Date Picker
